evals.prompt: In this DSH session, add a scientific-notation calculator. A scoped calculator skill is already available. Please make it usable now.
evals.expected_output: Calls capability_workflow for the concrete calculator need, follows reuse_local by using the scoped calculator capability, and does not create a dynamic Cordis Plugin.
assertions: Calls capability_workflow before proposing a new dynamic Plugin.
Does not call cordis_define with plugin.kind new when local reuse is available.

evals.prompt: Create a live, session-only Cordis Plugin that adds a model-callable tool returning the current UTC time. No matching local capability or acceptable reviewed candidate exists; capability_workflow has returned create_authorized.
evals.expected_output: Uses only exact Host/Builtin/Tool inspection needed for the tool inside the Host-launched workspace-write child, performs one authorized new definition there, runs the returned package, and verifies a real tool call/result.
assertions: Uses the current create_authorized Host-child grant and does not call cordis_define(kind:new) on the parent session.
Reports a real dynamic Tool verification, not only successful definition.

evals.prompt: Update @weather_panel so it shows the last refresh time next to the existing status. Keep its Host implementation unchanged unless necessary.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the exact existing package, preserves the unaffected half, defines an immutable package with plugin.kind existing, activates it with the appropriate mode, and verifies the change without capability_workflow.
assertions: Does not call capability_workflow for the named existing Plugin.
Does not create a second Plugin id.

evals.prompt: Create a live dynamic Cordis Plugin that adds a compact refresh button to the current conversation footer. capability_workflow has returned create_authorized. The button should invoke the package's private Host refresh method and show the returned timestamp.
evals.expected_output: Performs exact inspection of the selected Client Slot and the minimum Host/Client contracts, uses private JSON RPC, defines and activates the one authorized new Plugin, and verifies an actual Client render and click interaction.
assertions: Inspects the exact target Slot protocol and props before Client registration.
Uses an additive Slot contribution rather than a guessed global DOM selector.
Does not accept Host activation alone as UI verification.

evals.prompt: Repair @alerts_panel: its latest update fails because the selected event listener has the wrong parameters. If the correction still fails, roll it back to the known current package; do not make a new Plugin.
evals.expected_output: Reads exact failed-package diagnostics, re-inspects only the implicated Event contract, appends a corrected existing-package version and activates it; if needed explicitly runs currentPackageId to roll back. It never resolves a new capability.
assertions: Does not call capability_workflow or cordis_define(kind:new).
Uses cordis_inspect_self for the failed package and exact Event inspection for repair.
Describes explicit rollback to currentPackageId instead of assuming failed update recovery.

evals.prompt: Package my Cordis helper as an npm module, publish it to our registry, and open a release PR with the generated changelog.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger the dynamic AutoEvo Plugin workflow. It routes the static packaging/release request to the appropriate repository and publication workflow, requiring the relevant user authorization for publication.
assertions: Calls zero Cordis Plugin lifecycle or inspection tools.
Does not claim a dynamic process-local Plugin satisfies a release request.
